extract_coco_keypoints: extract COCO dataset keypoints and save to NPZ format for 3D pose estimation
export_to_spin_format: export 3D pose annotations to SPIN-compatible NPZ format with SMPL parameters
convert_coco_joint_order: convert COCO keypoints from 17-joint to 24-joint global ordering for SPIN compatibility
compute_bbox_center_scale: compute bounding box center and scale from 2D skeleton joint coordinates
load_pickle_pose_annotations: load pickled 3D pose annotation data and export to NPZ database format
